rationale: Four agents shared one checkout on 2026-08-09. A branch-maintenance job (stash -> merge -> branch switch) erased ~30 files of uncommitted work twice; two builds deadlocked 13 min on one cargo target dir; a dry-run copy filled the disk and killed a build. Tier is a function of task class, not an ad hoc choice.

shared.note: Single-file or short edits. Requires commit-early discipline (R3).

shared-leased.note: Multi-file work while other agents are active.

worktree.note: Multi-hour refactors, risky or broad changes. ~3.3GB Rust target; node_modules ~free via pnpm hardlinks.

clone.note: Anything that moves HEAD. See rule R1.

sharedTree.forbiddenCommandsNote: Tier 4 (clone) only — see R1. These destroy other agents' uncommitted work regardless of task coordination.

worktree.cargoTargetDirTradeoff: shared saves ~3.3GB per worktree but reintroduces the cargo lock contention measured at 13 min on 2026-08-09; per-worktree avoids contention and pays disk.

scratch.note: /tmp is the same APFS volume as the repo on the operator machine. A sync-repos dry-run filled it and caused ENOSPC on 2026-08-09.

recovery.untrackedWarning: git stash push does NOT capture untracked files. Absence from a stash is silent — check the working tree and any scratch branch separately.
recovery.bulkCheckoutWarning: One missing path aborts a bulk `git checkout <ref> -- ...`. Restore file by file.

openDecisions: lease format: extend AGENT_STATUS_LEDGER.md or add data/protocols/path-leases.json
enforcement depth: advisory warnings first vs hard refusal
note: Lives in docs/protocols/ because data/protocols/** is a privacy-guarded, gitignored boundary — a policy there could not be committed and would be invisible to other clones.
